explanation: The name comes from Latin cuneus, a wedge, after the marks the reed left. When Nineveh was sacked in 612 BC, fires baked many clay tablets hard and preserved them.

claims.text: Cuneiform was usually written by pressing a reed stylus into soft, wet clay.
Cuneiform was not normally written on papyrus, bamboo strips or palm leaves.
The word cuneiform comes from the Latin cuneus, meaning wedge.
Fires during the destruction of Nineveh baked many clay tablets hard, which helped them survive.
